label: Calendar
html:
<style>
  /* Agenda: the scaffold's own glue - the calendar look. Every control is a
     shipped component (Calendar, Date Picker fields, Toggle Group, Dialog,
     Select, Switch, Checkbox, Avatar, Badge, Table, Toast, Language
     Switcher); calendars and people carry their colour in --c */
  .ag {
    --ag-hour: 3rem;
    --ag-px: calc(var(--ag-hour) / 60);
    --ag-slot: 1.375rem;
    --ag-line: color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 70%, transparent);
    --ag-off: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 55%, transparent);
    --ag-free: oklch(0.68 0.15 150);
    container: ag / inline-size;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--scaffold-height, 50rem);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  .ag [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  .ag-top {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .ag-brand {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-inline-end: 0.5rem;
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  .ag-brand svg {
    color: oklch(0.6 0.2 25);
  }
  .ag-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ag-weekchip {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ag-spacer {
    flex: 1;
  }
  .ag-search {
    position: relative;
  }
  .ag-search .input {
    width: 12rem;
  }
  .ag-results {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 0.25rem);
    inset-inline-end: 0;
    z-index: 20;
    width: 20rem;
    max-height: 20rem;
    overflow: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    list-style: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--popover);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  }
  .ag-results button,
  .ag-upcoming button {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    column-gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: start;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-results button:hover,
  .ag-results button:focus-visible,
  .ag-upcoming button:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
  }
  .ag-results small,
  .ag-upcoming small {
    grid-column: 2;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  .ag-dot {
    width: 0.625rem;
    height: 0.625rem;
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--c);
  }
  .ag-body {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .ag-side {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
    flex: none;
    width: 17rem;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 35%, var(--background));
  }
  .ag[data-side-closed] .ag-side {
    display: none;
  }
  .ag-side .calendar {
    align-self: center;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
  }
  .ag-side-h {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .ag-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .ag-list li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .ag-list .checkbox {
    accent-color: var(--c);
  }
  .ag-list label {
    flex: 1;
    margin: 0;
  }
  .ag-upcoming {
    gap: 0;
  }
  .ag-main {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .ag-view {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  /* -- day and week: a time grid, events placed by their minutes ------- */
  .ag-tg {
    --cols: 7;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ag-tg-head,
  .ag-tg-allday,
  .ag-tg-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 4rem repeat(var(--cols), minmax(5.5rem, 1fr));
  }
  .ag-tg-head {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .ag-tg-corner {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  .ag-dayhead {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-dayhead b {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ag-dayhead[data-today] b {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    min-width: 1.875rem;
    height: 1.875rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(0.6 0.2 25);
    color: white;
  }
  .ag-tg-allday {
    grid-auto-rows: 1.5rem;
    grid-auto-flow: row dense;
    gap: 2px 0;
    min-height: 1.75rem;
    max-height: 5.5rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding-block: 2px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .ag-tg-allday > .ag-tg-label {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
    align-self: center;
  }
  .ag-tg-label {
    padding-inline-end: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    text-align: end;
  }
  .ag-bar {
    margin-inline: 2px;
    padding: 0 0.375rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 22%, var(--card));
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-align: start;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--c);
  }
  .ag-tg-scroll {
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }
  .ag-tg-grid {
    position: relative;
    height: calc(24 * var(--ag-hour));
  }
  .ag-hours {
    position: relative;
  }
  .ag-hours span {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-end: 0.5rem;
    top: calc(var(--h) * var(--ag-hour) - 0.5em);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ag-col {
    position: relative;
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ag-line);
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--ag-line) 0 1px, transparent 1px var(--ag-hour)),
      linear-gradient(
        to bottom,
        var(--ag-off) 0 calc(var(--ws) * var(--ag-hour)),
        transparent 0 calc(var(--we) * var(--ag-hour)),
        var(--ag-off) 0
      );
    cursor: cell;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .ag-col[data-weekend] {
    background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .ag-ev {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(var(--s) * var(--ag-px));
    left: calc((100% - 4px) * var(--col) / var(--cols-n) + 2px);
    width: calc((100% - 4px) / var(--cols-n) - 2px);
    height: max(calc(var(--d) * var(--ag-px) - 2px), 1.125rem);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 20%, var(--card));
    box-shadow:
      inset 3px 0 0 var(--c),
      0 0 0 1px var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    text-align: start;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-ev[data-short] {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    padding-block: 0;
  }
  /* one line: the title keeps its room, the time gives way first (a stand-up read "D... 9:30 AM - 9:45 AM") */
  .ag-ev[data-short] b {
    flex: 0 1 auto;
  }
  .ag-ev[data-short] span {
    flex: 0 1000 auto;
  }
  /* overflow: hidden lets a flex item shrink to nothing - the title must keep its line */
  .ag-ev > * {
    flex: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ag-ev b {
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .ag-ev span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  .ag-ev:focus-visible,
  .ag-bar:focus-visible,
  .ag-chip:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 1px;
  }
  .ag-ev[data-past],
  .ag-chip[data-past] {
    opacity: 0.65;
  }
  .ag-now {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    top: calc(var(--s) * var(--ag-px));
    z-index: 2;
    height: 2px;
    background: oklch(0.6 0.2 25);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ag-now::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-start: -5px;
    top: -4px;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: inherit;
  }
  .ag-ghost {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 2px;
    top: calc(var(--s) * var(--ag-px));
    height: calc(var(--d) * var(--ag-px));
    border: 1px dashed var(--ring);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 15%, transparent);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* -- month: weeks of day cells, the events as chips ----------------- */
  .ag-month {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
  }
  .ag-mhead,
  .ag-mweek {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: var(--wk, 0) repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .ag[data-week-numbers] .ag-month {
    --wk: 2.25rem;
  }
  .ag-mhead {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-align: end;
  }
  .ag-mhead span {
    padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
  }
  .ag-mweeks {
    display: grid;
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(5.5rem, 1fr);
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .ag-mweek {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ag-line);
  }
  .ag-wk {
    padding: 0.375rem 0;
    border: 0;
    border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--ag-line);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag:not([data-week-numbers]) .ag-wk {
    display: none;
  }
  .ag-mday {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ag-line);
  }
  .ag-mday[data-weekend] {
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .ag-mday[data-out] .ag-mnum {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  .ag-mnum {
    align-self: flex-end;
    min-width: 1.625rem;
    height: 1.625rem;
    padding: 0 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-mday[data-today] .ag-mnum {
    background: oklch(0.6 0.2 25);
    color: white;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .ag-chip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.0625rem 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-align: start;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-chip::before {
    content: '';
    flex: none;
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--c);
  }
  .ag-chip[data-allday] {
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 22%, var(--card));
  }
  .ag-chip span {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .ag-chip time {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ag-chip:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
  }
  .ag-more {
    align-self: flex-start;
    padding: 0 0.25rem;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* -- year: twelve Calendar components -------------------------------- */
  .ag-year {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15.5rem, 1fr));
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    padding: 1rem;
  }
  .ag-year .calendar {
    justify-self: center;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ag-year .calendar-heading {
    color: oklch(0.6 0.2 25);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* -- find a time: a lane per person, the free slots light up -------- */
  .ag-find {
    flex-direction: row;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ag-find-side {
    flex: none;
    width: 19rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 1rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .ag-find-side h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  .ag-find-side h3,
  .ag-find-main h3 {
    margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .ag-muted {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  .ag-person .avatar {
    --size: 1.5rem;
  }
  .ag-person .avatar-fallback {
    background: var(--c);
    color: white;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .ag-add {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  .ag-fields {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  }
  .ag-fields > * {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .ag-fields .label {
    margin: 0;
  }
  .ag-between {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  .ag-between .input,
  .ag-between .select {
    flex: 1 1 6.5rem;
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .ag-find-main {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 1rem;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .ag-find-main > * {
    flex: none;
  }
  .ag-legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  .ag-legend span {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
  }
  .ag-legend i {
    width: 0.75rem;
    height: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--c);
  }
  .ag-board {
    --n-slots: 16;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 3.5rem repeat(var(--days), minmax(5rem, 1fr));
    overflow-x: auto;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }
  .ag-board-head {
    padding: 0.375rem 0.25rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ag-board-head b {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  .ag-board-times {
    position: relative;
    height: calc(var(--n-slots) * var(--ag-slot));
  }
  .ag-board-times span {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-end: 0.375rem;
    top: calc(var(--i) * 2 * var(--ag-slot));
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    translate: 0 -40%;
  }
  .ag-fcol {
    position: relative;
    height: calc(var(--n-slots) * var(--ag-slot));
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--ag-line);
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--ag-line) 0 1px, transparent 1px calc(2 * var(--ag-slot)));
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-fcol > * {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(var(--s) / 30 * var(--ag-slot));
    height: calc(var(--d) / 30 * var(--ag-slot));
  }
  .ag-allfree {
    inset-inline: 0;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ag-free) 24%, transparent);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ag-free) 60%, transparent);
    color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ag-free) 70%, var(--foreground));
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ag-lane {
    top: 0 !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    left: calc(4px + (100% - 8px) * var(--i) / var(--n));
    width: calc((100% - 8px) / var(--n) - 2px);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ag-lane i {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    top: calc(var(--s) / 30 * var(--ag-slot));
    height: calc(var(--d) / 30 * var(--ag-slot));
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--c);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  .ag-opt {
    inset-inline: 1px;
    border: 2px solid var(--ring);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ag-sugg {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .ag-sugg li {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }
  .ag-sugg-when {
    display: grid;
    min-width: 9rem;
  }
  .ag-sugg-when span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ag-sugg li > .btn {
    margin-inline-start: auto;
  }
  .ag-faces {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
  .ag-faces .avatar {
    --size: 1.5rem;
  }
  .ag-faces .avatar-fallback {
    background: var(--c);
    color: white;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
  }
  .ag-faces [data-busy] {
    opacity: 0.3;
  }
  .ag-poll .table th[data-best] {
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ag-free) 18%, transparent);
  }
  .ag-poll .table-head small {
    display: block;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 400;
  }
  .ag-vote {
    min-width: 2.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ag-vote[data-vote='yes'] {
    background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ag-free) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ag-vote[data-vote='maybe'] {
    background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.8 0.15 85) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .ag-vote[data-vote='no'] {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  .ag-book {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: end;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  .ag-book .input {
    width: 16rem;
  }

  /* -- the event: a detail card anchored to the chip, the editor ------ */
  .ag-detail {
    position: fixed;
    inset: auto;
    margin: 0 0 0 0.5rem;
    top: anchor(top);
    left: anchor(right);
    position-try-fallbacks: flip-inline, flip-block;
    width: 18rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  .ag-detail .card {
    gap: 0.5rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  }
  .ag-detail h3 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
  .ag-detail dl {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
